name: The Migdal Room
description: Mandaean Canon and counter-gospel architecture. Lunar Arm theological node. The Migdal connection. Depends on Revelation Room and Sacred Heart system.

constitution.ontology: This locus originated in earlier model confabulation. That provenance was recognised, and rather than deleting the form the architecture adopted it as a queued, preservable object. The Surface Map records the origin as model-generated, human-adopted. It is not a historically attested room and is not an absence in the holdings: it is an adopted locus awaiting seating into a genuine gap or a later free address. Material adjacent to it exists in the archive — the Haran Gawaita and Mandaean strand runs through the Shark Ark documents (#639, #1101, #56), the Ω Tang Specification (#644) and the Central Navigation Map (#297) — but no document takes the room as its subject, and the room was never constituted.

gap_declaration.rule: Non-erasure applied to confabulated loci: the architecture adopts rather than deletes. An adopted locus is preserved, queued, and declared — it is not an absence and not a defect.
